dedupe_keys.name: supplementary data physics informed machine learning for power grid frequency modelling

description: A German research team deposits trained weights, hyperparameter results and SHAP interpretation artifacts for a physics-informed machine-learning model of grid frequency. Zenodo lists one public results archive, while the linked GitHub repository supplies Python 3.7 code, model classes and a tutorial. Its README points to the processed feature dataset in the separate grid-frequency Zenodo deposit and names the results directory expected by the script. This package can benchmark frequency dynamics or parameter inference in electricity-system resilience studies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model-result release. A limitation is that Zenodo marks the result-archive licence unspecified; the repository reports MIT for code, which does not automatically license the weights or upstream data. The trained architecture and performance may depend on the original ENTSO-E and operator time series. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. No archive was downloaded, no weights were loaded and no prediction was reproduced.
